text:
elaine: Heads-up — starting next Wed we'll enforce vendor egress allowlisting at the VPC egress gateway. Any service making outbound calls to third-party endpoints must be added to the new vendor-allowlist or it will be blocked. :rotating_light:

elaine: Also tightening service token scopes: tokens issued before 2024-10 will be pruned to least-privilege; new default scope is read-only for telemetry and must be explicitly widened for write/admin actions. Teams will get a 30-day window to adopt scoped tokens.

tom: How do teams declare a vendor? Link to form?

elaine: Use https://intra.redwood/sec/vendor-allowlist — fill vendor domain, purpose, expected RPS, contact, and whether TLS client-auth is used. We'll auto-approve dev/non-prod requests for a 48h test window.

sanjay: Are logging/metrics endpoints (Datadog, Honeycomb) exempt? Our infra ships directly to Honeycomb from sidecars.

elaine: Logging vendors are NOT exempt. Please add them and pick 'approved-non-prod' or 'approved-prod'. For sidecars we can pre-approve the sidecar's service identity; still need the form for audit.

ravi: Any CLI to find who is calling external hosts? I can do a mass audit.

elaine: Yes — run:
```
infra-audit egress --since=30d --format=csv > egress-30d.csv
```
That will list service, dest_host, dest_ip, count. We pushed a GH template in infra/egress-audit-template.md.

sanjay: Who's owning firewall rollouts? Need a test window so alerts don't flood.

beth (sre): SRE will do phased rollout: dry-run for 24h in staging, then enforced in prod during a 4h test window next Wed 10:00-14:00 UTC. We'll open a paged channel during rollout and mute noisy alerts via temporary suppression rules.

elaine: If you need an exemption, submit the vendor form and tag @security. Exemptions will be timeboxed and logged. Non-compliant calls after enforcement will get 403 / connection reset. We'll provide a whitelist export for teams.

deploy-bot: Incident automation scheduled: add label 'egress-blocked' to deploys that trigger >10 egress errors/min.

kevin: Will this affect integrator keys (long-lived tokens we give partners)?

elaine: Yes — partner tokens must be rotated to scoped tokens. We will issue migration guides and an automated rotation job for partner integrations using OIDC; for legacy static tokens teams must rotate within 30 days or we'll disable them.

tom: Thanks. I'll run the audit and fill forms for Honeycomb + Datadog today.

sanjay: ack. creating PR to tag sidecar identity.

elaine: Appreciate it — will post final rule set and FAQ in #eng-security tomorrow. :thumbsup:
